about.lead: Netra means eye. Most small businesses lose real money on work a machine could do, and nobody has time to look. We look, we measure, then we fix it.
about.founder: KNETRA was founded by Karthikeya, a computer science student and backend and AI engineer, building from Hyderabad.

promises.name: Results you can measure
promises.text: Every project starts and ends with numbers in rupees and hours.

promises.name: Your language, your channel

promises.name: Care with your data
promises.text: No medical advice from bots, a clear hand-over to your staff, and conversation logs you control.

p: When you send the contact form, we receive your name, business name, phone number, the service you chose and your message. The form is delivered to our email through Formspree, a form service.
The leak calculator runs only in your browser. The numbers you type are not sent anywhere.
When you tap a WhatsApp or email link, the conversation happens in that app and is covered by its own privacy terms.
We use your details only to reply to you and to prepare your consultation. We do not sell or share them for marketing.
For the chatbots, WhatsApp bots and calling agents we build, you control the conversation logs. Our bots do not give medical advice and hand over to your staff when a person is needed.
The website's hosting provider may keep basic technical logs, such as IP addresses, to run and protect the site.
We use Vercel Web Analytics to count page visits, contact form sends and taps on WhatsApp links. It uses no cookies and does not identify you.
To see, correct or delete the details you sent us, email kompellakartikeya@gmail.com and we will act on it.
